_comment: CloudWatch Alarms — sends alerts when something goes wrong in the contact centre

alarms._comment: Alert if more than 10 customers are waiting — means we need more agents
alarms.AlarmDescription: Too many customers waiting in queue. Consider adding agents.

alarms._comment: Alert if Lambda functions are failing — means customer lookups may be broken
alarms.AlarmDescription: CustomerLookup Lambda is throwing errors. Check CloudWatch logs.

_howToSetup.step1: Create an SNS topic called 'ConnectAlerts' in your AWS Console
_howToSetup.step2: Subscribe your email to that SNS topic
_howToSetup.step3: Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID with your actual AWS account ID
_howToSetup.step4: Import this config via AWS CLI or create alarms manually in CloudWatch console
